items.t: HC Wainwright & Co. Maintains Buy on BioNTech, Lowers Price Target to $110

items.t: Moderna Needs a Post-Covid Hit. Its Cancer-Drug Spending Plan Ups the Stakes.

items.sum: Moderna's 3% post-earnings gain reflects stronger overseas COVID-19 sales and higher 2026 guidance, while oncology advances offer growth potential.
